startUrls.title: Wallapop Search URLs
startUrls.description: Paste one or more Wallapop search URLs (e.g. https://es.wallapop.com/search?keywords=iphone+15).

maxItems.title: Maximum Listings
maxItems.description: Maximum number of listings to extract per run (0 = unlimited).

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel Workers
maxConcurrency.description: Number of simultaneous search URLs processed at once.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy settings to prevent rate limits.
